comment: Measured with bench.sh (cua CLI + daemon, cua-vz) on an M2 Max Mac Studio (96 GB, macOS 26.6.2), image ghcr.io/trycua/linux:24.04-slim, 2 vCPU / 2 GB Spaces, 256 MiB written to the source's tmpfs before the checkpoint; the mean of two runs (2026-10-20). check.py fails when a p50 is more than `factor` times these, or memory per fork grows past `factor` times per_fork_mib. A fork's memory is its own (no sharing between forks): about its configured RAM right after the restore.
